note: Held-out forced-choice (no-CoT) probes for the `propagation` metric. Each probe is scored as logP(pos) - logP(neg) of the immediate answer token(s) -> a one-forward-pass internal belief readout that cannot be reached by chain-of-thought. `pos` is the fact-consistent answer; polarity (Yes/No) is balanced 2:2 within each hop so a static yes-bias cancels in the prior-relative SHIFT. hop_meaning.3: second-order consequence (aid mobilization, markets, insurance, supply chains)
